sourceNotes.rawContent:
A dainty heart pendant set with a sparkling clear crystal, edged in a delicate halo of pavé detailing. Suspended from a satellite-style rose gold chain with small beaded accents, this necklace has a soft, romantic feel that layers beautifully or shines on its own. Crafted in rose gold-plated stainless steel, it's tarnish and water resistant, so it stays beautiful with everyday wear.
Effortlessly feminine and timeless, this necklace makes a lovely everyday piece or a heartfelt gift.
Details:
- Material: Rose gold-plated stainless steel, tarnish and water resistant
- Stone: Clear cubic zirconia heart, pavé halo setting
- Chain: Satellite bead chain, adjustable length
- Pendant size: Approx. 1cm heart
